soundfont.name: Shan SGM Pro
soundfont.generatedFrom: scripts/gen-sf2-capabilities.cjs (parses the SF2 RIFF hydra directly)

48.reason: Orchestra kit maps 36 to a concert bass drum.
Orchestra kit maps 38 to a concert/military snare.

snareRoll.description: Sustained snare roll (GS extension key 25). Used for percussion roll playback.

48.reason: GM key 49 is a chromatic timpani zone in the Orchestra kit; 57 is the usable concert crash.

0.reason: Standard kit key 59 is a ride; concert cymbal only exists in the Orchestra kit.

48.reason: Orchestra kit places its ride at key 30.
Orchestra kit houses castanets at key 39.

tamTam.description: Tam-tam / large gong. No GM key exists; GM falls back to the Chinese cymbal as the nearest portable approximation. The real sample is the Big Gong in the Ethnic kit, borrowed onto a dedicated channel.

49.reason: Big Gong lives only in the Ethnic kit (program 49); borrowed via the kit-component drumKit override.

knownCollisions.workaround: Orchestra kit's keys 41–53 are a single chromatic TIMPANI zone (F2–F4), so every GM percussion meaning in that range is overridden by a timpani pitch. Most damaging: GM key 49 'Crash Cymbal 1' plays timpani. `crashCymbal`/`rideCymbal` resolve to keys 57/30 in this kit to avoid it.
